source_refs.note: Exercise 5.2, Question 5 (book p. 158); answer key PDF 306

blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Find the interior angles of the triangle whose vertices are: \(A(2, 3)\), \(B(6, 3)\), \(C(4, 7)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh triangle ke interior angles (andar wale angles) ka sawal hai, aur humare paas sirf vertices ke coordinates hain.
Pehle teeno sides ke slopes nikalenge, phir har vertex par Theorem 7 lagayenge.
Sab se ahem cheez: kis side se kis side tak naapna hai. Vertices ko anticlockwise ghoomein, aur har vertex par agle vertex wali side se pichhle vertex wali side tak naapein (jaise Example 13 mein).
Aakhir mein jama \(180^\circ\) check karenge.
Asaan pehchaan: vertex par khare ho kar figure ke andar ki taraf munh karein; daayen haath wali side se baayen haath wali side tak naapna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(2, 3)\), \(B(6, 3)\), \(C(4, 7)\).
Maloom karna: interior angles \(A\), \(B\), \(C\).
Tareeqa: \(A\) neeche baayen, \(B\) neeche daayen aur \(C\) upar hai, is liye \(A \to B \to C\) anticlockwise hai. To \(A\): \(AB\) se \(AC\) tak; \(B\): \(BC\) se \(BA\) tak; \(C\): \(CA\) se \(CB\) tak.

Sides ke slopes
\[m_{AB} = \dfrac{3 - 3}{6 - 2} = 0\]
\[m_{BC} = \dfrac{7 - 3}{4 - 6} = -2\]
\[m_{CA} = \dfrac{7 - 3}{4 - 2} = 2\]
Kyun: slope \(= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}\). Side ka slope dono taraf se ek hi hota hai, \(m_{AB} = m_{BA}\). \(AB\) horizontal hai, is liye slope 0.

Angle \(A\) (\(AB\) se \(AC\) tak)
\[\tan A = \dfrac{2 - 0}{1 + (0)(2)} = 2\]
\[A = \tan^{-1} 2 = 63.43^\circ\]
Kyun: Theorem 7 mein \(m_1 = m_{AB} = 0\) (jahan se ghoomna) aur \(m_2 = m_{AC} = 2\) (jahan tak).
Is tarah har angle andar ki taraf naapa jata hai. Agar galti se ulta naap lein to \(180^\circ\) minus angle milega, jo exterior angle hota hai.

Angle \(B\) (\(BC\) se \(BA\) tak)
\[\tan B = \dfrac{0 - (-2)}{1 + (-2)(0)} = 2\]
\[B = 63.43^\circ\]
Kyun: \(m_1 = m_{BC} = -2\), \(m_2 = m_{BA} = 0\).
Dhyan dein: agar yahan order ulta karte to \(\tan B = -2\) aata aur \(116.57^\circ\) milta, jo exterior angle hai, interior nahi.

Angle \(C\) (\(CA\) se \(CB\) tak)
\[\tan C = \dfrac{-2 - 2}{1 + (2)(-2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{-4}{-3} = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
\[C = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{4}{3} = 53.13^\circ\]
Kyun: \(m_1 = m_{CA} = 2\), \(m_2 = m_{CB} = -2\); upar neeche dono negative, jawab positive.

Tasdeeq:
\[63.43^\circ + 63.43^\circ + 53.13^\circ = 179.99^\circ \approx 180^\circ \;\checkmark\]
(\(0.01^\circ\) ka farq sirf rounding ka hai.) Saath hi \(AC = \sqrt{20} = BC\), yani triangle isosceles hai aur \(A = B\), bilkul jaisa aaya.
Khulasa: triangle ke angles nikalne ka yeh tareeqa hamesha kaam karta hai: slopes, anticlockwise tarteeb, har vertex par Theorem 7, aur aakhir mein \(180^\circ\) ka check.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(66.4^\circ, 66.4^\circ, 53.1^\circ\) chhapti hai. In ka jama \(185.9^\circ\) hai, is liye yeh triangle ke angles ho hi nahi sakte. Sahi angles \(63.4^\circ, 63.4^\circ, 53.1^\circ\) hain (\(\tan^{-1} 2 = 63.43^\circ\)). Key ki ek alag line '(iv) \(53.1^\circ, 63.4^\circ, 63.4^\circ\)' mein yahi sahi values hain; Question 5 ka koi part (iv) hai hi nahi.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Find the interior angles of the triangle whose vertices are: \(L(1, 2)\), \(M(5, 5)\), \(N(7, 2)\).
blocks.explanation:
Wohi tareeqa jo part (i) mein tha, lekin pehle direction check karni hai.
Yahan \(L \to M \to N\) clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ki taraf) chalta hai, kyunke \(M\) upar hai aur \(N\) daayen.
Is liye hum \(L \to N \to M\) ki tarteeb lenge jo anticlockwise hai, aur har vertex par agle vertex wali side se pichhle vertex wali side tak naapenge.
Aakhir mein jama \(180^\circ\).
Direction pehchanne ke liye graph par teeno points halke se bana lein; kaunsa point upar hai aur kaunsa daayen, yeh dekh kar tarteeb foran samajh aa jati hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(L(1, 2)\), \(M(5, 5)\), \(N(7, 2)\).
Maloom karna: interior angles \(L\), \(M\), \(N\).
Tareeqa: \(L\) aur \(N\) dono \(y = 2\) par hain aur \(M\) upar, is liye \(L \to N \to M\) anticlockwise. \(L\): \(LN\) se \(LM\) tak; \(N\): \(NM\) se \(NL\) tak; \(M\): \(ML\) se \(MN\) tak.

Sides ke slopes
\[m_{LM} = \dfrac{5 - 2}{5 - 1} = \dfrac{3}{4}\]
\[m_{MN} = \dfrac{2 - 5}{7 - 5} = -\dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[m_{LN} = \dfrac{2 - 2}{7 - 1} = 0\]
Kyun: do points se slope; \(LN\) horizontal hai, slope 0.

Angle \(L\) (\(LN\) se \(LM\) tak)
\[\tan L = \dfrac{\frac{3}{4} - 0}{1 + 0} = \dfrac{3}{4}\]
\[L = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{3}{4} = 36.87^\circ\]
Kyun: \(m_1 = m_{LN} = 0\), \(m_2 = m_{LM} = \frac{3}{4}\).
Yahan sab se zaroori kaam tarteeb sahi rakhna hai; agar hum \(L \to M \to N\) le lete to har angle ka order ulta ho jata aur obtuse exterior angles aate.

Angle \(M\) (\(ML\) se \(MN\) tak)
\[\tan M = \dfrac{-\frac{3}{2} - \frac{3}{4}}{1 + \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)}\]
\[= \dfrac{-9/4}{-1/8} = 18\]
\[M = \tan^{-1} 18 = 86.82^\circ\]
Kyun: \(m_1 = m_{ML} = \frac{3}{4}\), \(m_2 = m_{MN} = -\frac{3}{2}\). Upar \(-\frac{6}{4} - \frac{3}{4} = -\frac{9}{4}\), neeche \(1 - \frac{9}{8} = -\frac{1}{8}\); \(\frac{9}{4} \times 8 = 18\).
Dhyan dein: tan 18 bohat bara hai, yani angle \(90^\circ\) ke qareeb hai magar us se chhota.

Tasdeeq:
\[36.87^\circ + 56.31^\circ + 86.82^\circ = 180^\circ \;\checkmark\]
Khulasa: teeno angles positive tan se aaye, yani teeno acute hain, aur \(M\) sab se bara hai kyunke us ke saamne wali side \(LN = 6\) sab se lambi hai. Triangle mein sab se lambi side ke saamne sab se bara angle hota hai, yeh bhi ek achhi tasdeeq hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(36.9^\circ, 19.4^\circ, 123.7^\circ\) chhapti hai. Is mein sirf \(L = 36.9^\circ\) sahi hai. \(L(1, 2)\), \(M(5, 5)\), \(N(7, 2)\) ke liye \(\tan M = 18\) se \(M = 86.8^\circ\) aur \(\tan N = \frac{3}{2}\) se \(N = 56.3^\circ\) aata hai. (Cosine rule se tasdeeq: \(LM = 5\), \(MN = \sqrt{13}\), \(LN = 6\), \(\cos M = \frac{25 + 13 - 36}{2 \cdot 5\sqrt{13}} = \frac{1}{5\sqrt{13}}\), is liye \(M = 86.8^\circ\).)
